## 🛠️ Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds offline survival functionality)

- [ ] Automated / Smoke tests executed (`python scratch/test_backend.py`)
- [ ] Frontend builds cleanly (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Verified behavior in 100% offline mode (Network disconnected / airplane mode)
